claims.claim_text: Executive leadership centers on IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization while shaping an operating model for platform IP and partner-led growth.
From that commercial base, platform productization connects AI capability to joint solution development and disciplined lifecycle decisions.
Against that lineage backdrop, alliance operating cadence and AI-driven sales frameworks supported 20% joint revenue growth.
In parallel, release automation and security scanning were embedded into regulated modernization delivery paths.
That operating foundation also generated $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and scaling the team through platform productization.
Future leadership can align alliance execution, secure modernization, and platform IP growth around repeatable customer outcomes.
